# Payanywhere is the all-in-one payments platform that powers your business.

Accept payments and run your business with free software, hardware, and low rates.

Get started

## Payanywhere makes accepting credit cards easy for business owners, employees, and customers.

Let Mallory show you what Payanywhere can do (it’s a lot).

## Your business + Payanywhere.

Accept credit cards in your store, online, and on the job site.

## Retail.

Accept credit cards in your store. Choose from a variety of hardware options that fit the style of
your business. Sell from your inventory, run open tabs, collect tips, and send or print receipts.

[More about Retail ][40]

## Mobile.

Never miss a payment. Turn your smartphone or tablet into a mobile point of sale with a Bluetooth
credit card reader and the Payanywhere app. You can even accept contactless payments with only an
iPhone with Tap to Pay and the Payanywhere app.

[More about Mobile ][41]

[More about Tap to Pay on iPhone ][42]

## Online.

Get paid with one-time or recurring invoices that your customers pay online. Save cards on file and
offer autopay options. Take orders over the phone or online and process payments with a virtual
terminal.

[More about Online ][43]

## Manage your business with powerful software.

Payments Hub is the online merchant portal empowering smarter business decisions. View deposits,
manage transactions and dispute chargebacks, and pull real-time reports. Go beyond payments with
account, employee, and inventory management tools.

[Homepage manage business]

## Payment devices for your countertop or on the go.

Smart terminals, mobile devices, and point of sale systems designed with flexibility in mind. Start
accepting payments wherever you or your customers are.

[Compare Hardware][44]

## Developers.

You build your product; Payanywhere powers the payments. Create unique payment experiences on your
website or in your app. Plug into a complete payments ecosystem with just a few lines of code.

[Visit Developer Hub][45]

## Make payments a growth engine for your business

#### Online payments

Offer flexible online payments with credit cards, debit cards, eChecks, and major digital wallets
like Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal for secure, convenient checkout.

[ [Learn more about online payments] ][38]

#### Smartphone payments

Accept secure mobile payments with smartphones, supporting QR codes, digital wallets, and fast
tap‑to‑pay options for easy checkout.

[ [Learn more about mobile payments] ][39]

#### In person with a card reader

Use Virtual Point of Sale to connect a card reader to your computer, sign in, and accept reliable
in‑person payments quickly and securely.

[ [Learn more about Virtual Point of Sale] ][40]

#### Over the phone

Process phone orders securely by entering customer details in the Virtual Terminal, allowing quick
manual payments through any web browser.

#### eCheck

Enable simple eCheck payments for recurring billing, invoices, and contactless transactions,
offering a low‑cost, dependable digital alternative.

#### Simple Checkout

Add Buy Now or Donate buttons to your site for fast checkout, ideal for nonprofits and merchants
selling single items or low‑volume products.

** About Us**

**Bluei Store** have made and maintained solid relations with many clients through its competitive
skills. By adopting latest production techniques and by implementing thorough testing and quality
analysis procedures, the company has successfully etched business marks as a ***manufacturer ***of
**Fast Travel Charger, Micro Data Cable, Mobile Power Bank, Mobile Charger, Bluetooth Speaker,
Mobile Tool, Data Card, Data Cable, etc**., - all under the brand name ***Bluei***.

At Bluei Store, nothing beats quality and we always ensure products designed at our facility go
through rigorous testing. Besides, every department is steered by expert technicians and engineers
following work methodologies that are regularly reviewed by a team of quality analyzers. These
professionals keep a check on products and processes and ensure corrective actions and measures for
product improvement are arranged, as and when required. By paying keen attention to quality and
making sure rightful standards are observed at all levels, we have attained goodwill of a large
client base.

As a part of our improvement-centric culture, we always welcome valuable suggestions of clients.

**
Infrastructure Facilities**

We aim to provide innovative and exceptional quality products to clients and this becomes a
possibility as we manage a large and resilient technical base. Here our team works round the clock
to cater to clients from industries of all sizes. Data Cable, Mobile Power Bank, Mobile Tool, Data
Card, Mobile Charger, etc., are produced in bulk at good speed at our manufacturing setup, which is
powered by other units like a quality testing centre, warehousing area, admin dept., among others.
Machines, hardware and software at all facilities are upgraded and also employee training programs
are arranged time to time.

**
Why Us?**

The diverse and versatile gamut of products that we deal in is carefully designed balancing quality,
profitability and functionality, which makes the range extremely popular in the market. In addition,
our market excellence is attributable to:
* Product delivery made on-time
* Quality products at bargain prices 
* Products featuring cutting edge technology
* Experts and knowledgeable people having high professional ethics at our service

**
Brands We Deal In**
* Sony
* HTC
* Apple
* Canon
* Palm
* Hewlett-Packard

**
Our Team**

We owe excellent product acceptability in markets around India to a team of proficient professionals
who have good market know how and are abreast with novel technology related to manufacturing of Data
Cable, Mobile Tool, Mobile Charger, etc. This experienced and competent staff we have includes:
* Electrical engineers
* Software engineers
* Technicians
* Procurement agents
* Warehousing personnel
* Logistics personnel
* Administration staff
* Skilled workers

**
Client Satisfaction**

We never compromise on quality and performance of our products and ensure our range aligns with
needs and expectations of our clients. We take note of various application challenges of clients and
design innovative products that address their needs effectively, providing them complete
satisfaction.

**
Quality Assurance**

Our aim is to sustain excellence marks as a trusted partner of clients, providing them with a
valuable quality control experience like no other. Thus, we comply with international standards
during product design and test our complete array of Data Cable, Power Bank, etc., on following
parameters before packaging & storage:
* Ease of use
* Design
* Power efficiency
* Finishing
* Durability

**We accept a minimum order quantity of 10 pieces on all products.**

# Welcome to CardCom Technology

 

## Hardware solutions for magnetic stripe and smart card applications

 

> Concentrating on the development of new technology since its inception, CardCom Technology now
> faces the new millennium as the leader for Integrated Electronic Payment System covering Auto ID
> Products, Automatic Fare Collection, Telecommunication and E-commerce.

### Automatic ID Products

> CardCom Technology offers quality Magnetic Card Readers, Smart Card Readers, Card Dispensers, and
> Issuing Machines that will satisfy any set of requirements. Custom configurations are available
> for all OEM products, including modification of standard units as well as development of new
> models to meet the product specification required by customers.

### POS & ID Checking Equipment Terminals

> In response to the proliferation of ID theft, fake IDs, and underage drinking and smoking, CardCom
> Technology brings you the ViAge series, a complete ID checking solution. As the leader in ID
> detection, there is only one place to go for your Auto ID needs! The ViAge family includes the
> CAV-2000 and CAV-3000 series (which covers five different models with varying functions) offering
> diversity in ID checking solutions to satisfy any retailer. Whether you opt for the low end or
> high end ViAge solution, all terminals have features of data capture, accurate and quick reading,
> age and date of birth display, compactness, portability and affordability.

> For POS scanning and ID verification in one, the [CAV-3200 POS][26] is ideal for supermarket and
> convenience stores. It reads UPC, UCC/EAN, RSS and CS symbology and reads the magnetic stripe and
> 1D and 2D barcode off of state and provincially issued drivers licenses and identification cards.

# ****Start Accepting Credit Cards****

******

 

 

***Card Service Professionals ***welcomes you to our site. Please scroll through and visit all our
tabs for the latest resources, updates, content and guides. Please reach out via the contact form if
you need more information. We thank you for visiting. 

*Card Service Professionals, [an independent sales agent][17], helps you effortlessly and seamlessly
accept payments from all major credit cards, debit cards and checks and process payments through
state of the art POS systems.*

***Credit Card Processing*** remains an essential offering for merchants today. With more than 80
percent of all retail customers paying with credit and/or debit cards, credit card acceptance is no
longer an option for merchants, it’s a necessity.  For brick and mortar stores, customers expect to
have the ability to pay with a credit or debit card. In fact, consumer expectations in terms of
enhanced value, such as those offered by mobile payments, is on the rise, so merchants seeking a
real competitive advantage. Additionally, as major card issuers migrate to EMV technologies
merchants with in-store credit card processing must be prepared with not only the appropriate
hardware, but also the right technology.

***E-commerce*** continues to grow in the U.S. at a staggering rate. According to 2012 predictions
from Forrester Research, online shoppers in the U.S. will spend $327 billion in 2016 up 45 percent
from $226 billion in 2012, and is expected to reach $750 billion by 2020.

***Mobile credit card processing***, or mobile payment acceptance, is a becoming more and more
popular with smaller micro-merchants or those just starting out. Mobile credit card processing
allows merchants to accept credit and debit card payments via a smartphone or tablet and provide a
quick and easy portable solution.

So whether adding an online shopping experience to an existing brick and mortar location or starting
a new business exclusively online, credit card processing is a must-have.

can see your future based on the cards you have drawn.

manuscripts.

company. We plan to keep expanding our customer base by finding more talented vendors in the
future. 

Our company works as a celebrated **distributor **and **supplier **of the domain under the
leadership of two talented mentors, **Mr. Narayan Singh Rathore & Mr. Ganpat Singh Rathore.** They

installation services for our offered range.

support, we manage to complete each of our tasks with great efficiency and success. They are the
biggest asset of our company, Their expertise and talent have been immensely useful to our
enterprise since the beginning of our journey. We are hoping to train them and hone their skills
further in the future. Our company is currently backed with skilled:
* Technicians
* Procuring agents
* Quality controllers
* Warehousing and packaging experts
* Sales and marketing executives, etc.

About Us
**About Us**

We, **Mahadev Computers,** are working since 2001 in the market. Our company has been appreciated
for our immense talent for Surveillance Systems as well as IT Solutions. Never holding back, we
bring forth the most reliable gamut of **Hikvision Camera, *****Hikvision IP Network Cameras,
Network Video Recorders, Hikvision DVRs, ESSL Biometric Machines,*** etc. The range meets high
expectations of clients and comply to the standards of the domain. To continue doing so, we have
partnered up with a long list of reliable vendors, only handpicking those who have proven themselves
as the best. Procuring a huge collection from them, we have garnered a huge customer base for our
company. We plan to keep expanding our customer base by finding more talented vendors in the
future. 

Our company works as a celebrated **distributor **and **supplier **of the domain under the
leadership of two talented mentors, **Mr. Narayan Singh Rathore & Mr. Ganpat Singh Rathore.** They
guide us to work in an ethical manner and motivate our team to maintain utmost transparency with
clients at all times. With the support of such leadership, we also manage to render highly reliable
installation services for our offered range. 

**Our Co-operative Unit- Our Team**

Our company has the support of a co-operative unit, i.e. our team of talented experts. With their
support, we manage to complete each of our tasks with great efficiency and success. They are the
biggest asset of our company, Their expertise and talent have been immensely useful to our
enterprise since the beginning of our journey. We are hoping to train them and hone their skills
further in the future. Our company is currently backed with skilled:
* Technicians
* Procuring agents
* Quality controllers
* Warehousing and packaging experts
* Sales and marketing executives, etc.

# Tap and ride on subways and buses. See your trips and charges online.

[Learn more][22]

## Tap and ride: Pick your payment method

Choose how, when, and where to pay the fare:

[
[contactless credt, debit, and prepaid cards]

### Tap your contactless card

Check if your contactless credit, debit, or reloadable prepaid card has the contactless symbol on
the front or back. If so, tap it at an OMNY reader to pay the fare and GO.

Learn about contactless cards

][23]
[
[phones]

### Tap your phone or smart device

Add a payment card to your digital wallet, then tap your device at an OMNY reader and GO.

Learn about digital wallets

][24]
[
[contactless tapping]

### Tap an OMNY card

Want to pay with cash? Buy and load value on an OMNY card, then tap it at an OMNY reader to pay the
fare and GO.

Learn about OMNY cards

][25]

## Earn free rides by tapping

Tap and ride for 7-Day Unlimited benefits! When you tap the same card or device for 12 individual
trips within 7 days, you’ll get unlimited free rides for the rest of the week.

[Learn more about the fare cap][26]

## One secure account to manage your travel

Enjoy convenient features when you register for an OMNY account.
[Get started][27]
[Dashboard]

### Reload your OMNY card

Reload your OMNY card automatically with your credit, debit, or commuter benefits card.

[Progress]

### Track progress toward your 7-day fare cap

See how close you are to free rides.

[Cards]

### Manage your travel cards

Manage your bank cards and OMNY cards — all in one place.

[Customer service]

### Contact customer service

Submit your questions to customer service quickly and easily.

## Have questions?

# PharmacyChecker Research

## **Not Made in the USA**

#### The Global Pharmaceutical Supply Chain and Prospects for Safe Drug Importation

Many consumer products clearly state where those products are made. Not so for prescription
medications. Where our drugs are made and where their main ingredients are sourced affects drug
safety, affordability, availability, and even national security — concerns that have come to the
fore as a result of the global pandemic. Yet there is too little transparency and too much
misinformation surrounding the supply chain of the drugs we take. “Not Made in the USA” investigates
and details the country of manufacture and the source country for active pharmaceutical ingredients
among widely used, brand name prescription drugs.

[VIEW OUR LATEST RESEARCH][47]

Our team of experts ensures you get the answers to your questions related to obtaining lower-cost
prescription medication from Canada and other countries.

## Verification Program

#### The PharmacyChecker Verification team accredits international online pharmacies that meet high
#### standards of pharmacy practice by evaluating them in the [PharmacyChecker International
#### Pharmacy Verification Program][54]. To verify that they meet PharmacyChecker standards,
#### pharmacies must prove adherence to the laws in the countries where they operate in addition to
#### PharmacyChecker policies.

[ [Example PharmacyChecker seal] ][55]
* Prescription orders dispensed by licensed pharmacies
* Requires a Prescription
* International sales of controlled drugs to the U.S. prohibited
* Meets website security requirements
* Publishes customer privacy policy on website
* Publishes contact information on website for customer service
* Pharmacist consultation offered to customers
* Quantities marketed on website restricted to a maximum of 3 months' supply at a time
* Disclosure of pharmacy location to consumer prior to purchase
* Marketing claims are truthful and not misleading

# Sanchar Saathi Portal – TAFCOP, Download App & Check SIM Card Details 2026

The **[Sanchar Saathi Portal][18]** is a citizen-friendly initiative by the Department of
Telecommunications (DoT), Government of India, aimed at protecting mobile users from fraud, misuse,
and mobile theft. Through this platform, users can check how many SIM cards are linked to their
Aadhaar, verify the authenticity of their mobile devices, and even block lost or stolen phones. The
integrated system also ensures that telecom services remain transparent and accountable.

In an era of rising digital threats, identity theft, and SIM-related scams, Sanchar Saathi empowers
users to monitor and manage their telecom connections securely.

## **What Is Sanchar Saathi Portal?**

Sanchar Saathi is both a web portal and a mobile app that provides multiple services related to
mobile security and SIM verification. It combines several key modules developed by the DoT to
strengthen consumer safety:
* **CEIR (Central Equipment Identity Register) –** a database that tracks and blocks lost or stolen
  mobile phones.
* **TAFCOP (Telecom Analytics for Fraud Management and Consumer Protection)** – a platform that
  helps users check the number of active SIMs issued in their name.
* **KYM (Know Your Mobile) – **a service that allows users to verify if a mobile device is genuine
  or blacklisted.

The Sanchar Saathi Portal ([www.sancharsaathi.gov.in][27]) allows users to access these features
under a single interface, making it easy to check SIM cards, block stolen phones, and safeguard
personal data.

## **Why Sanchar Saathi Portal is in News**

Recently, the Sanchar Saathi App came into the spotlight when the Department of Telecommunications
issued new directions on 28 November 2025. According to the latest rules, all mobile phone
manufacturers and importers must pre-install the Sanchar Saathi app on every new device sold in
India.

This step aims to make security features accessible to every smartphone user and ensure that
individuals can quickly report lost devices, verify IMEI numbers, and prevent SIM misuse without
needing separate apps or websites.

## **Objectives of Sanchar Saathi Portal**

The main objectives of the Sanchar Saathi Portal are:
* To protect citizens from fake, duplicate, or tampered mobile devices
* To prevent SIM frauds and identity misuse
* To help users report lost or stolen phones easily
* To support cyber safety and block suspicious activity
* To improve transparency in the telecom sector by letting users monitor their own connections

By integrating TAFCOP Sanchar Saathi and CEIR services, the portal strengthens both consumer
awareness and network-level protection.

## **Understanding TAFCOP – Sanchar Saathi Know Your Mobile Connection**

TAFCOP Sanchar Saathi is an essential component of the Sanchar Saathi system. It enables users to
find out how many SIM cards are linked to their identity using their Aadhaar or mobile number.

Here’s how you can use the TAFCOP portal for Aadhaar card mobile number check:
1. Visit the official [**TAFCOP Portal**][28]
2. Enter your mobile number and click on Generate OTP
3. Verify the OTP received on your registered phone
4. The system will display all active SIM cards associated with your Aadhaar number
5. If you find an unknown connection, you can report or block it directly from the portal

This process, also known as Sanchar Saathi SIM Check, ensures that your telecom identity is not
misused for unauthorized activities.

## **Central Equipment Identity Register (CEIR) – Role and Functions**

The CEIR system plays a crucial role in maintaining the national IMEI database. Every mobile phone
has a unique IMEI (International Mobile Equipment Identity) number. The CEIR helps ensure that only
genuine devices operate on Indian telecom networks.

**Functions of CEIR include:**
* Blocking lost or stolen phones across all Indian networks
* Preventing the use of fake or cloned IMEI numbers
* Assisting police and security agencies in tracing stolen devices
* Allowing users to unblock recovered devices

Through CEIR, users can visit the Sanchar Saathi Portal, enter their IMEI number, and block a stolen
phone instantly. This helps reduce mobile theft and the illegal sale of blacklisted devices.

# About

We are Tarot and AI enthusiasts who believe that everyone should have access to divine guidance
regardless of where they are in life. Our online AI Tarot reader can be used for fun, learning, or
for some quick advice when you need it most. Try your first question on us!

We believe that AI will never have the same personalized human touch as a human Tarot reader. Tarot
readings involve not only an understanding of the symbolism and meaning of the cards, but also the
ability to empathize and connect with those seeking guidance. Making personal connections can be a
crucial element of the Tarot reading experience.

AI cannot (yet) fully replicate human subjective interpretation, and therefore cannot fully replace
a human Tarot reader.

If you enjoyed your reading, please consider donating to help us keep this site up and running.

[[Donate with PayPal]][2]
[[Buy Me a Coffee at ko-fi.com]][3]

# Frequently Asked Questions

## What is Tarot?

Originating in the 15th century, Tarot is a set of cards used for divination, meditation, and
psychological insight. Each one of the 78 Tarot cards has rich symbolism and diverse
interpretations. In a Tarot reading, the meaning of each card unfolds in relation to its position
and the reader's intuition, offering nuanced perspectives. Tarot is used for various purposes,
including self-reflection, personal growth, decision-making, and exploring different perspectives on
life's challenges and opportunities. This ancient practice not only connects us with historical
wisdom but also serves as a mirror to our inner selves.

## How does this site work?

It's simple! In the text box above, just type your question or the situation on which you are
seeking guidance. The cards will be drawn for you. Our AI Tarot reader will provide a personalized
reading based on your question.

## How many questions can I ask?

You can ask up to 3 follow-up questions per reading.

## How much does this cost?

For any reading, your first question is free! If you'd like to ask follow-up questions to gain more
insight, you can purchase follow-up credits by clicking the shopping cart. Each follow-up credit is
good for one additional question. You can ask 3 follow-up questions per reading.

## What is a credit and account ID?

Use credits to ask follow-up questions as a part of your reading. An account ID is a unique
identifier generated in your browser that keeps track of your follow-up credits. If you lose your
account number (such as by clearing your browser), don't worry, we can help you recover it so you
never lose the follow-up credits you've purchased.

## What if I lose my account ID?

If you lose your account ID, you can recover it by clicking 'Recover Account' button. Enter the
email you used to purchase your follow-up credits, and we'll send you an email to recover your
account and any unused credits.

## How long are my credits good for?

Credits don't expire. Use them as you wish.

## Can I share my reading with others?

Yes. You can click the 'Copy Link' button to get a link to your reading and share with others.
